tools.name: Negative Thought Journal
tools.description: Write down the situation and the automatic thought in three or six columns, name the distortion, and answer it with reason.

tools.name: Negative Thought Counter
tools.description: Just one number a day: how often negative thoughts showed up. A line across the days shows the change.

tools.name: Daily Activity Plan
tools.description: Plan your day across fourteen time slots, note what actually happened, then rate mastery and pleasure.

tools.name: Anti-Procrastination Table
tools.description: Break a task into small steps and compare predicted versus actual difficulty and satisfaction. The dread shrinks.

tools.name: The "But" Rebuttal
tools.description: For every "but …" excuse, write a more realistic, more rational rebuttal — until procrastination has nowhere to stand.
